cards.title: Which environment do we replay against?
cards.issue: Replayed requests need a target. Replaying against production risks real side effects.
cards.context:
The replay tool re-sends recorded requests and compares the two runs field by field.

- Staging has less data, so some requests return empty results.
- Production data is realistic, but writes would be real.

recommendation.why: Staging is safe for writes, and most recorded requests are reads that still return useful data.

options.label: Production, reads only
options.detail: Realistic data. Needs a guard that blocks any write call.

options.label: Staging
options.detail: Safe. Some responses will be empty.

options.label: Both
options.detail: More work. Gives a staging versus production comparison.

cards.title: How should fields that always differ be handled?
cards.issue: Timestamps and request ids change on every run, so they show up as false differences.
cards.context: A **small ignore list** removes most noise. Anything not on the list is still compared.

options.label: Learn the list from two identical runs

cards.title: Where should replay results be stored?
cards.issue: Results are needed for a few days so the diff can be re-read.
cards.context: No option is recommended here. This is a preference question.

cards.title: Is `x` shown as plain text?
cards.issue: Card text must never break the page. This card is a check that markup is escaped.
cards.context: Inline `code`, a [link](https://example.com), and **bold** text should render. This tag must show as text.
